doc_a.text:
Lab comparison notes for Auralis QuietPro 3:
- (5/5) In a 40-person office ANC bench, Auralis QuietPro 3 cut mid-band HVAC noise by 28 dB average with stable seal on three common ear shapes.
- (4/5) Bluetooth multipoint kept a laptop call and a phone notification stream without dropouts across a full workday test.

doc_b.text:
Lab comparison notes for HarborSound HX-900:
- (5/5) HarborSound HX-900 scored highest transparency mode speech clarity in a sidewalk café recording replay (listener panel n=18).
- (4/5) Folding hinge and hard case survived a 1.2 m drop onto tile three times with no mic or driver failure.
- (3/5) List price undercuts QuietPro 3 by ~18% at the same retail tier while including a USB-C dongle for older laptops.
